meanings.gloss: to drive, to go (by car, train ...), to travel
meanings.morph: infinitive; present, 1st/3rd person plural; formal imperative

sentences.review: fahren doesn't specify that the speaker drives, and the entry's own concept stresses it just means going by vehicle, so 'drive home' is too specific; suggest 'I want to go home.'

sentences.text: Jack und Jane fahren zusammen nach Paris.
sentences.en: Jack and Jane are going to Paris together.

sentences.text: Fahren Sie bitte nicht so schnell!
Mein Vater will nicht mehr Auto fahren, er ist zu alt.
sentences.en: My father doesn't want to drive anymore; he's too old.

sentences.text: Ich möchte mit ihnen nach Wien fahren.
sentences.en: I'd like to go to Vienna with them.
